note: The Evidence Engine registry: every load-bearing statement of the package with its status marker, verdict address, uncertainty budget and pre-committed falsification criterion. Statuses: exact | measured-law | honest-negative | hypothesis | comparison. The registry is validated by qhb/claims.py and pinned by tests/test_claims.py. Quoting a claim obliges carrying its status and verdict address (the honesty discipline, LICENSE).
